api_version.description: The version of the API. This is a simple integer that increments when API is changed.

build_number.description: The build number of the server.

commit_hash.description: The commit hash of the server.

debug_build.description:
Whether this binary was compiled with debug assertions (a debug build).
Defaults to `false` for peers that do not report it.

display_name.description: Display name of the remote desk.

operation_system.description: Operation system associated with the version.

remote_desk_type.description: Remote desk type associated with the version.

repository_url.description:
Source repository URL this binary was built from, when known.
Defaults to `None` for peers that do not report it.

token.description: Authentication token for server nodes or API clients.
